scope.placement: independent P/D processes on one resident H100

acceptance_totals.excluded: Partial successful cases in the two failed preliminary jobs and synthetic-draft contract seeds are excluded.

source_versions.v1: Initial matrix and structured P/D graph config; no reservation availability wait and no D target-forward guard. Four existing DSpark regressions pass; first matrix and AR regression stop at missing publication/failure assertions.
source_versions.v2: Combined observer rejects extra D target prefill. Prefill validation requests wait for reservations and require exact admissions and no backpressure. Complete nine-case matrix passes.
source_versions.v3: Generalizes the same capacity wait and admission assertions to the existing correctness fixtures; cohort routing bypasses the pre-reservation wait because cohort admission is lazy. AR and natural-pressure graph regressions pass. Production capture code is unchanged in all three versions.
source_versions.validation_equivalence: The nine-case v2 matrix enables validate_prefill_graph and uses TP1/PP1; all its generate/abort requests already take the same capacity wait and exact-count checks as v3. The added request_router branch is not taken for this topology.

verification.black: Four changed/new Python files pass black --check.
verification.ruff: Four changed/new Python files pass full ruff check.

preliminary_failures.observation: Full overlap returned ten generation results but its second batch left total publications at 29 instead of 30, after passing ten eager and ten Breakable samples.
preliminary_failures.interpretation: The log lacks final admission counters for that case, so it does not establish object loss or the exact cause. Replacement reservations are asynchronous; the corrected correctness driver waits for available reservations and checks every admission.

preliminary_failures.observation: Eager passed; graph overlap did not record the expected failed aborted capture.
preliminary_failures.interpretation: Final admission counters are absent at failure. The final fixture establishes capacity before the streamed abort; both AR tests pass with exact admission counts.
